verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm selling advisory services, not a software platform that holds user data, so self-service export of 'all of my data' in open formats is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only legal service descriptions, free downloadable templates and absent API/llms.txt endpoints. None of it shows a data export or portability capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
